subject: AWS Marketplace: metering & fulfillment orchestration for DataStream Analytics
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: AWS Marketplace: initial ask for metering + fulfillment artifacts (DataStream Analytics)

Team,

We got confirmation from DataStream (Raj) that they want us to go live on AWS Marketplace SaaS (co-sell) for their enterprise account. AWS is asking for the usual metering + fulfillment artifacts before we can complete onboarding and start entitlement testing.

Key asks I need us to align on today:
- SKU mapping and metering dimension(s) (they currently have 2 products: "Stream Pro" — consumption tokens/sec, and "Stream Teams" — seat-based). Which SKU/dimension will we expose?
- Entitlement activation webhook: payload schema and the endpoint that will accept the activation from AWS (sandbox).
- Contract/legal inputs: are we doing rev-share terms in the SaaS contract or go with standard marketplace fulfillment?
- A single spreadsheet with SKU -> plan -> pricing -> metering_dimension that we can hand to AWS.

I attached entitlement_matrix_v1.xlsx to get us started (stub). Ben, can you run the SKU/pricing mapping and propose a final CSV for AWS? Marissa, can you flag any legal constraints if we need to modify the SaaS contract template for marketplace terms? Soojin, please advise if this will affect onboarding flow/CS handoff.

Quick timeline suggestion: draft SKU mapping by EOD today, legal check tomorrow morning, hand to Amy (AWS) by end of day Monday so we can start entitlement verification next week.

Thanks — Nikhil

-- 
Nikhil Sharma
Head of Integrations, Redwood Inference
nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0193

From: Amy Dalton <amy.dalton@aws-partner.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@datastream-analytics.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace: initial ask for metering + fulfillment artifacts (DataStream Analytics)

Hi Nikhil — great to hear you are moving forward. High-level notes and attachments attached (aws-fulfillment-requirements.pdf).

Requirements for SaaS metering + fulfillment (summary):
- Provide final SKU catalog as CSV: sku_id, sku_name, metering_dimension, unit_label, price_per_unit, billing_period.
- Metering dimensions supported: Consumption (numeric) and Seat (licensed_user_count). If you expose both, they must be distinct SKUs and clearly documented for entitlement mapping.
- Activation: AWS will POST a provisioning webhook to your sandbox URL. The payload will include buyer_account_id, entitlement_id, and sku_id. You must respond with HTTP 200 and an activation token within 30s for provisioning to be marked succeeded.
- Deactivation & change events: support change and revoke flows (we'll provide sample payloads).
- Fulfillment verification: you must provide a publicly accessible test endpoint (or a signed tunnel) for our validation team to call.
- Reporting/usage: daily metering CSV upload to S3 or the recommended metering service API; we prefer S3 for larger volume — include path/permissions for the test bucket.
- Contract notes: if you require any non-standard commercial terms (rev-share exceptions, custom billing cadence), include them now — legal will route.

Deliverables to send back: final CSV (saaS_pricing_SKUs.csv), webhook endpoint and sample payload handling, and a sandbox S3 path for usage deliveries. I attached the template and sample payloads.

DocuSign: once SKU + fulfillment flow agreed, we'll route the AWS fulfillment agreement; here's the preliminary envelope: https://docusign.net/envelope/ABC123def456

Amy
Partner SA, AWS Marketplace
amy.dalton@aws-partner.com
Attachments: aws-fulfillment-requirements.pdf (6 pages, stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 12:48:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace: initial ask for metering + fulfillment artifacts (DataStream Analytics)

Nikhil / Marissa —

Thanks for the heads up and Amy for the checklist. I reviewed DataStream's current pricing model and put together a proposed split:
- DSA-STRM-PRO (consumption) — metering_dimension=stream_tokens_per_sec (rate). Price tiers: 0-1M units/month @ $0.0008/unit, 1M-10M @ $0.0006, etc.
- DSA-STRM-TEAMS (seat) — metering_dimension=licensed_user_count. Monthly per-seat pricing mapped to their "Teams" plan.

I created saaS_pricing_SKUs.csv (attached stub) and an entitlement_matrix_v1.xlsx that maps SKU -> internal_plan_id -> billing_id. For the activation webhook, propose the following sandbox URL: https://sandbox.redwood.ai/marketplace/activate (will return {"status":"ok","activation_token":"<token>"} on success). We'll support change/revoke with the same endpoint and an action field.

Questions for legal: if DataStream wants to include a 60-day refund window or custom invoice cadence (net-60), does that require any additional fulfillment changes on our side? My assumption is billing cadence is handled off-band via Marketplace billing unless they ask for invoice-level adjustments.

Proposed timeline updated: finalize CSV by EOD, hand to Amy Monday for validation, aim for entitlement validation Wed/Thu.

Ben
Senior Product Ops, Redwood Inference
Attachments: saaS_pricing_SKUs.csv (stub)

On Sat, Nov 14, 2026 at 10:05 AM Amy Dalton <amy.dalton@aws-partner.com> wrote:

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@datastream-analytics.com>, Amy Dalton <amy.dalton@aws-partner.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 16:38:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace: initial ask for metering + fulfillment artifacts (DataStream Analytics)

Thanks, all — quick legal + ops note and next steps.

1) Legal (marissa):
- Standard AWS SaaS fulfillment agreement covers the typical revenue share and billing flow. Custom payment terms (net-60 or refund windows) need an addendum and will delay sign by ~7-10 business days. If DataStream insists on net-60, we should capture that now so Amy can route the DocuSign with the addendum.
- Please redact any customer PII in the entitlement test payloads before we send them to AWS test environment.

2) Ops (soojin):
- CS onboarding: once entitlement activation succeeds in sandbox, we need to run a simulated activation with a seeded buyer_account_id to exercise onboarding playbooks. Soojin will own the test run and collect results.

3) Deliverable owners and deadlines:
- Ben: finalize saaS_pricing_SKUs.csv and entitlement_matrix_v2.xlsx — due EOD 11/14.
- Nikhil: provide sandbox webhook endpoint and a minimal test harness for AWS to call (public endpoint or ngrok) — due 11/15 EOD.
- Marissa: confirm whether we proceed with standard agreement or request addendum for net-60 — will advise by 11/15 AM.

Raj / Amy — cc'd you to keep DataStream in the loop. If DataStream can accept standard terms, we can keep to the tighter timeline. Otherwise please indicate which contract modifications are required.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
--
Attachments referenced: entitlement_matrix_v2.xlsx (planned), proposed-test-playbook.md (CS steps)
